newsitem.title: USA: Iron Mountain sees no effect from NJ fires.
newsitem.headline: Iron Mountain sees no effect from NJ fires.

text.p: Iron Mountain Inc said on Wednesday that it did not believe fires at its South Brunswick, N.J., records centers would have an adverse effect on the company's financial health.

In a statement accompanying the company's first quarter earnings results, Iron Mountain said that based on its current assessment, "management does not believe the fires will have a material adverse effect on the company's financial condition or results of operation."

The company added that business was resumed within 24 hours of the last and largest fire, which occurred on March 17, and that Iron Mountain continues to serve South Brunswick customers from an alternate location.
The company reported that three fires occurred in March and said that records were lost in the flames. The company also said the fires were of suspicious origin.

Iron Mountain, a records management company, reported that its first quarter earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, amortization and extraordinary charges had increased to $10.2 million compared with $7.6 million for the first quarter of 1996.
